snippet.title: Lich of Might Trailer
snippet.description:
Lich of Might is an indie action game where the player is the boss at the end of the dungeon.

Release on Steam coming in late April.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4485760/Lich_of_Might/

Track used in trailer: Mountain Trial
